{{Top|title=''Auzituck'' anti-slaver gunship}} {{StarshipClass |image=[[File:WookieeGunship-2024ToppsSWHyperspace.png]] |name=''Auzituck'' anti-slaver gunship |designer= |manufacturer=[[Appazanna Engineering Works]]''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Visual Guide]]'' |line= |model= |type= |cost=95,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' |modifier= |sysmods= |length=14.7 [[meter]]s |width=7.6 meters |height=6 meters |mass= |max accel= |mglt= |max speed=950 [[Kilometer per hour|km/h]]''[[Star Wars Rebels: Head to Head]]'' |maneuverability= |engine= |hyperdrive=*Class 2 {{C|primary}} *Class 12 {{C|backup}} |hdrange= |hdsystem=[[Hyperdrive|Equipped]] |poweroutput= |power= |shield gen=[[Deflector shield|Equipped]] |hull= |sensor= |target= |navigation= |avionics= |maincomp= |countermeasures= |armament=[[Sureggi (company)|Sureggi]] twin [[laser cannon]]s (3) |complement= |bays= |escapepods= |crew=*One [[pilot]] *One co-pilot/[[gunner]] |skeleton= |passengers=8 |capacity= |cargohandling= |consumables=One [[Standard month|month]] |lifesupport= |communications= |othersystems= |availability= |role= |firstuse= |retired= |affiliation=*[[Kashyyyk resistance]] *[[Citizens' Fleet]]''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]'' }} The '''''Auzituck'' anti-slaver gunship''', also called the '''''Auzituck''-class gunship''', or the '''Wookiee gunship''', was a [[gunship]] manufactured by [[Appazanna Engineering Works]] and used by [[Wookiee]]s to battle [[Slavery|slavers]]. ==Description== [[File:Wookiee_Liberator_Auzituck_Gunship_XWM.png|thumb|left|250px|An ''Auzituck'' in space]] ''Auzituck'' roughly translated to "liberated one" in [[Shyriiwook]], the native [[language]] of the [[Wookiee]]s. The [[gunship]] was fast, well-[[armor]]ed and heavily armed with a narrow profile and large [[engine]]s. It had a dual-tiered, bubble-shaped canopy that housed the [[pilot]] in the upper, rear section with the copilot and [[gunner]] in the lower forward position. The interiors were made from [[wroshyr tree]]s, with sap serving as glue.''[[The Rebellion Begins]]'' ==History== During the [[early rebellion against the Galactic Empire]], one such [[Starship|vessel]], serving as a freedom fighter against the [[Galactic Empire]], was contracted to meet with the crew of the ''[[Ghost]]'' by [[Cikatro Vizago]]. But by the [[time]] it arrived, it had been raided by [[Trandoshan]] [[enslaver]]s and left adrift, and the crew had been sold to the Empire.
[[File:Ghost_and_Auzituck.png|thumb|left|250px|An ''Auzituck'' gunship docked with the ''Ghost''.]]
Another gunship later rendezvoused with the ''Ghost'' to recover the Wookiee crew they had [[Mission to free Wookiee prisoners|rescued]].''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]'' The Wookiee [[bounty hunter]] [[Krrsantan]] also owned [[Black Krrsantan's Auzituck anti-slaver gunship|his own]] ''Auzituck'' gunship during the [[Galactic Civil War]].[[Darth Vader (2015) 8|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 8]] Wookiee gunships joined the [[Citizens' Fleet]] during the [[Battle of Exegol]] in [[35 ABY]] between the [[Resistance]] and the [[Sith Eternal]].{{Film|IX}} events is dated to [[35 ABY]] as ''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary'' states its events took place one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|Starkiller Incident]], which took place in [[34 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''. ==Behind the scenes== The ''Auzituck'' anti-slaver gunship first appeared in ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]'', the one-hour premiere for the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. The name "Auzituck" dates back to the [[May]] [[1973]] [[The Star Wars rough draft|rough draft]] of what ultimately became [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': ''Episode IV A New Hope'']]. In scene 135 of that script, which was set in the "Wookee [sic] camp," an early version of Chewbacca was greeted by his father, Auzituck, Chief of the [[Chewbacca's family/Legends|Kaapauku]] tribe.{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarz.com/starkiller/2010/03/the-star-wars-rough-draft|text=The Star Wars—Rough Draft|work=The Jedi Bendu Script Site|archivedate=20111004132652}} [[File:Auzituck_Gunship_DoR.png|thumb|right|200px|An ''Auzituck'' gunship firing its forward cannons.]] The young readers book ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Head to Head]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and featuring various match-ups from the series, placed a patrol gunship against an [[Gozanti-class cruiser|Imperial freighter]], with the gunship damaging the freighter and escaping. In the episode ''[[Peril on Kashyyyk]]'' of ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures]]'', Wookiees use the gunships to raid a [[Trandoshan]] prison camp.{{FreemakerAdventures|Peril on Kashyyyk}} Later in the season two episode ''[[A Perilous Rescue]]'', the rebels take cover in a crashed gunship before being [[Skirmish on Kashyyyk (Freemakers)|rescued]] by the [[Freemakers/LEGO|Freemakers]] flying the [[Arrowhead (Freemakers)|''Arrowhead'']].{{FreemakerAdventures|A Perilous Rescue}} The ship, particularly the distinctive bubble cockpits, resembles the real-life Mi-24 "Hind" helicopter gunship, much like the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|LAAT]]. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Auzituck anti-slaver gunships}} *[[Han Solo & Chewbacca 4|''Han Solo & Chewbacca'' 4]] *''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]'' {{1st}} *''[[The Rebellion Begins]]'' *''[[Ezra's Wookiee Rescue]]'' *''[[The Secret Jedi: The Adventures of Kanan Jarrus: Rebel Leader]]'' *{{RebelsMagCite|27|A Time to Survive}} *''[[Doctor Aphra: An Audiobook Original]]'' *[[Darth Vader (2015) 8|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 8]] *[[Darth Vader (2015) 14|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 14]] *[[Darth Vader (2015) 20|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 20]] *[[Darth Vader (2015) 21|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 21]] *[[Darth Vader (2015) 22|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 22]] *[[Darth Vader (2015) 23|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 23]] *[[Darth Vader (2015) 25|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 25]] *{{Film|IX}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *{{LegoMiniMovie|a-lXl5g6SZY|Episode 10 -
